what: An 8px bordered square crosshair pinned at the center of the screen. When the pointer goes over a target (photo or product), the square grows to 20px and rotates 90° (.8s power3.out), .05s later the inner fill unfolds with clip-path (.75s), and text like OPEN PROJECT rises from below 16px to its right. On leave it returns to 10px and 0° and the text exits upward. It is white with difference blending, so it shows the background and photo colors inverted.

options.size-out: Square size on exit (px), default 10 — the initial 8px size is set in css
options.[data-crosshair]: Turns on when a hand rises over any element in the document carrying this attribute — the value is the adjacent label
options.Event fx:crosshair: For targets without an element, like the WebGL version, use document { on: true, label } / { on: false } fires — when turned off, label: "" If so, clear the text first and then fold (original playground)
